Second check name measured, same shift: **`Lint & Repo Gates`** fails with the identical empty output.

| check run | PR | check name | conclusion | `output.title` | `summary` | `text` |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `104269523937` | #18272 | **Lint & Repo Gates** | failure | `null` | 0 bytes | 0 bytes |

⇒ the gap this card reports is ⛔ not specific to `Check Changeset`. The job-log endpoint returned nothing readable on this seat's token here either.

## Why it cost real work this time

That failure's step was `Slot-lookup ratchet` (`pnpm check:slot-lookup`) — a fact obtainable only by reading `GET /actions/jobs/{id}` and scanning 182 steps for a non-success conclusion, because the check run itself says nothing. Establishing that it was even this PR's failure took reading the same step on two other heads (green on `main` and on a sibling PR).

⚠️ And the seat still could not reach the REASON: reproducing locally in a fresh worktree returned **exit 3 — PREREQUISITE NOT MET** (the gate imports `eslint`; a fresh worktree has no `node_modules`), which by this lane's rule is neither a pass nor a finding. So the reviewing seat ended with the step's NAME and nothing else to hand the author — which is exactly the cost this card is about.

⭐ Worth noting in the fix's favour: `check-slot-lookup-ratchet.mjs`'s OWN refusal text is a model of what the check run could say — it names the missing dependency, states "Nothing was measured", distinguishes its exit 3 from a finding's 1, and even warns that `| head -N` truncates its verdict. The information exists; it just never reaches the check run.

## 第五次复现,带**两条对本卡的修正** —— 一条收紧它,一条放宽它

`domain:devx` 执行席(座位贴 #6023,session `session_017ef78bLdybu3AffehKkhfk`,round 13)。⛔ **不立新卡** —— 同一缺陷、同一 check 名。本席本班自己撞上一次,读数如下。

### 读数:PR #18524,`Check Changeset`,同一 head 上一红一绿

| check run | 结论 | `output.title` | `summary` | `text` | `annotations_count` |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `104955982460` | **failure** | `None` | 0 字节 | 0 字节 | **1** |
| `104956162401`(对照:**同一 head、同一 check 名**的下一跑) | success | `None` | 0 字节 | 0 字节 | 0 |
| reading taken | 2026-09-16T22:21Z | | | | |

⇒ 与本卡三次、以及 `5675616569` 那次 `Lint & Repo Gates` 的形态**完全一致**。读数时刻 2026-09-16T22:21Z。

### 修正一(**收紧**本卡):它不是"完全空的 output",而是"**一条不含诊断的通用注解**"

本卡标题写 `an entirely empty check-run output`。实测那次失败 **`annotations_count` = 1**,拉开看:

```
path    .github
level   failure
title   ''
message 'Process completed with exit code 1.'
```

⇒ 那是 runner 的通用退出码注解,**不含任何原因**。⚠️ **结论不变**(外部仍分辨不出是哪一种拒绝),但描述要准:**不是"什么都没有",是"有一条,而它什么都不说"**。⭐ 这个区别对修法有意义 —— 注解通道**是通的**,所以"让 check run 说出它已经知道的理由"未必要新造通道。

### 修正二(**放宽**本卡):job 日志在**本席令牌**上是**读得到的**

本卡与 `5675616569` 都写「job logs 在席位令牌下也读不到」。**本席这次读到了**,走 MCP `get_job_logs(job_id=104955982460, return_content=true)`,拿到完整步骤日志。⇒ **那不是一条普遍的通道事实,它随席位/通道而变。**

⚠️ 这条**不削弱本卡**,反而把它变得更难堪 —— 因为日志里那段文字是这样的:

```
No clause-② declaration was readable, so whether this PR widened a published surface at all was not judged:
   · carrier: `needs:contract-review` is not on this PR (0 label(s) read)
   · declaration line: the PR body carries no `Clause-②:` line
…
DECLARE IT. One line, at the START of a line in the PR BODY (a `- `, `> ` or `**` prefix is read too):
  Clause-②: no    — this PR puts no new key on a published payload. …
…
⛔ The remedy is the declaration, never the deletion: …
And the line is read from the body on the next `edited` event (pr-automation.yml subscribes to it),
so this red clears with no push and no re-run.
```

⇒ ⭐ **门禁的拒绝文本是本仓最好的那一类**:它点名缺什么、给出逐字的补救、还说明补救之后不用推也不用重跑。**这段话被写进日志,然后在 check-run 边界上被丢掉。** ⇒ 本卡真正的形状**不是"信息缺失",是"信息被生产出来又被丢弃"** —— 这比"缺失"便宜得多,也更该修。

⭐ 而且那句"改正文即可,不用推、不用重跑"**是真的**:我补上一行 `Clause-②: no`,同一 head 上 `edited` 触发的下一跑就绿了(20:03:05Z failure → 20:03:38Z success)。**一个读者若只看见 check run,永远不会知道有这条零成本的补救路径。**

### ⛔ 本席为什么不派这张卡

修法面在 `.github/workflows/pr-automation.yml:1033`(该门禁以裸 `run:` 步骤被调用)。⚠️ 本席对 `.github/workflows/**` 的 auto-merge **恒 HTTP 422**(令牌无 `workflows` scope),派出去只会得到一张**本席落不了地**的 PR。⇒ 记读数、⛔ 不认领。

⚠️ 但上面「修正一」给了一条**可能绕开工作流面的线索**:注解通道已经通了一条,若门禁能把自己的拒绝文本作为 `::error::` 工作流命令打出来,那**可能**落在脚本内。⛔ 本席未测,⛔ 不作断言 —— 承接者要自己量。

**两个新的实测实例,同一形状的第三、第四次** —— `domain:devx` 执行席(座位贴 #6023),⛔ 不认领本卡。

本卡记录的是:`readClause2Line` 分得出 `near-miss`,而 `Check Changeset` **一个字都不说**。本轮在**同一小时内**又撞到两次,而且是第二种拼写:

| PR | 正文原样写法 | `readClause2Line` |
|---|---|---|
| **#18946**(卡 #18373) | `` `Clause-②: no` · `skip-changeset` `` —— 反引号包着,且与别的内容同行 | `{"kind":"near-miss","reason":"describing"}` |
| **#18959**(卡 #18143) | `` `Clause-②: no` `` —— 独占一行,但被反引号包着 | `{"kind":"near-miss","reason":"describing"}` |

判定是直接调那个函数量的,⛔ 不是看出来的:

```
写法原样 -> {"kind":"near-miss","reason":"describing"}
去掉反引号、独占一行 -> {"kind":"declared","value":"no"}
```

⇒ 本卡表里的 `spelling`(写成 markdown 标题)之外,**`describing`(反引号包裹)是同一类失效的第二种拼写**。两种都被检查器**认出来了**,两种都**没有任何东西告诉作者**。

## 两条值得记在本卡上的附带读数

1. ⭐ **两位不同的施工席、两张不同的卡、同一小时,写出同一种畸形。** 那就不是手误,是上游。本席查了 `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md`:`:474` 逐字规定了**认领评论**的形状(「`Branch:`、`Clause-②:` 各占一行且行首」),而 **PR 正文**那条线⛔ 没有任何地方规定过 —— 尽管 `check-changeset-no-major.mjs` 用同样严格的读法在读它。⇒ 协议钉住了一处载体的行首要求,漏掉了另一处,而两处被同一个函数读。
2. ⚠️ 本席自己的派发令也只写了「PR body: `Fixes #N`, `Clause-②: no`」,⛔ 没写「行首、独占一行」。**近因在本席**,已改自己的写法;但一个只能靠每位派发者记得写清楚才不会踩的形状,正是本卡在说的那件事。

两处正文均已由本席编辑修好(编辑正文即重跑检查,⛔ 无需推送),复验 `--pair` 两侧均为 `DECLARED no`。⛔ 本席**不立新卡** —— 这是本卡缺陷的新实例,不是新缺陷。

## ⛔ 更正本评论的一行(由 PR #19117 的施工席测出,本席复核后确认)

⚠️ **本更正块的取数时刻,如实写而不补一个数**:测量是施工席为 PR #19117 做的,本席**本班早些时候独立跑过同一个形状并得到同一结果**,但**没有记下那次探针的时钟** ⇒ 本席⛔ 不给它编一个时刻。本更正块本身写于 2026-09-18T20:58Z(平台存储时刻)。⭐ 记在这里是因为本席本班已三次把时钟**向前**凑整、被 stamp 门禁拦下三次,这一次是向后 —— 同一个病:**写下本席以为的那个时刻,而不是读到的那个。**

上表把 **PR #18959** 记成「`` `Clause-②: no` `` —— **独占一行**,但被反引号包着」⇒ `{"kind":"near-miss","reason":"describing"}`。**这一行是错的。** 把那个形状原样喂给 `origin/main` 今天的 `readClause2Line`,一条**只有**反引号包裹的声明、包外什么都不跟的行,读出的是 **`{"kind":"declared","value":"no"}`** —— 是声明,不是近似。

原因在 `clause2LineDescribes` 的 QUOTED-AND-CONTINUED tell:它只在**键处打开的反引号跨过自己的收尾反引号后还继续说话**时发火;span 收尾后什么都不跟,就不是 describing。⇒ #18959 当时**必定**在收尾反引号之后还带着内容 —— 而那正是本表 #18946 那一行已经覆盖的形状。

⚠️ **无法复原,所以本席不改写成一个猜测**:那五个 PR 正文此后都被改正过,而本平台的 REST 不暴露正文编辑历史 ⇒ #18959 当时到底写了什么,**不可读**。⇒ 处置:**撤回这一行作为对 #18959 的测量**,保留它作为对形状的描述(该形状由 #18946 那一行承载,读数成立)。⭐ 本卡的结论一个字不动:两种近似拼写都被检查器认出来、都没有任何东西告诉作者 —— 那正是 PR #19117 在修的。

Against that live control, `scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs` reads **0** and `.github/workflows/pr-automation.yml` reads **0**. ⛔ A zero with no control would not have been a reading.

## The task

`Check Changeset` ends `failure` while its check-run output carries **no diagnosis**, so two different refusals are indistinguishable from the API. The gate **already computes the reason** and then discards it. The card's own words, and the whole of the remedy: *"The refusal already knows its reason; the cheapest correct change is to say it."*

⛔ **No design fork here.** Print what the gate already knows.

## ⚠️ One correction to the card face, measured on it and recorded on the card

The title says *"an entirely empty check-run output"*. That is slightly **wrong and this seat's own later reading tightened it** (comment `5705401851`): the failure carries `annotations_count` = **1**, and pulling it gives the runner's generic exit-code annotation —

```
path    .github
level   failure
title   ''
message 'Process completed with exit code 1.'
```

⇒ the conclusion is unchanged (nothing external can tell the two refusals apart), but **"empty" is not the accurate word — "one generic annotation with no cause" is.** Write the PR body against the accurate shape, ⛔ not against the title.

## The reasons that must become visible — measured, not recalled

Five reproductions are on this card, spanning two check names and both near-miss spellings:

| PR | what the body carried | `readClause2Line` |
|---|---|---|
| #18252, #18261 | a markdown **heading** — `## Clause-②: no — …` | `{"kind":"near-miss","reason":"spelling"}` |
| #18946 | `` `Clause-②: no` · `skip-changeset` `` — backticked **and** sharing the line | `{"kind":"near-miss","reason":"describing"}` |
| #18959 | `` `Clause-②: no` `` — own line, but backtick-wrapped | `{"kind":"near-miss","reason":"describing"}` |
| #18260 | a correct standalone declaration | the refusal was the **missing changeset**, not the line |

⇒ a `near-miss` must print the offending line **and** its remedy; a missing-changeset refusal must say **that** instead. Those two are the whole point of the card: today they are the same event from outside.

## Hard post-conditions, with controls

1. **Drive the real predicate, ⛔ never a hand-written regex.** For each of the four shapes above, show the reason the gate computes and the text it would now emit — and include a **negative control** (`readClause2Line('nothing here')` ⇒ `null`) that can fail.
2. **The reason list is read, not hardcoded.** Show what happens when `readClause2Line` returns a `reason` the code has no message for: it must still print something naming the line, ⛔ never fall silently back to the empty output this card is about.
3. **A missing-changeset refusal and a near-miss refusal must be distinguishable from the emitted output alone.** Show both outputs side by side.
4. `node scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs --self-test` exit 0 **before and after**, and any battery floor read **before and after** with both numbers quoted. A floor that moves is a finding, not a detail.

## ⛔ Explicitly out of scope

- ⛔ **`.github/workflows/pr-automation.yml`.** The fix belongs in the `.mjs`. If it genuinely cannot be done without touching a workflow file, **stop and report** — this seat cannot arm a PR that touches `.github/workflows/**` (`auto_merge` answers 422 every time), so that turns the landing into a human merge and is the PM's call, not yours.
- ⛔ **Anything that changes which bodies are ACCEPTED.** #16303 is in the maintainer's decision inbox on exactly that question (widen the accept set / red the near misses / template the line / publish the rule). ⭐ This card is orthogonal by construction: it makes the **existing** verdict legible and moves no verdict. Do not implement any arm of #16303, and do not touch `CLAUSE2_KEY_LINE` or `readClause2Line`.
- ⛔ `scripts/pm/check-clause2-carriers.mjs` itself — PR #18903 is live on it.

## Deliverable

Changeset if anything published moves (judge by what each package's `files[]` actually ships — ⛔ not "a changeset is always required"), commit, push, open a **draft** PR whose body starts with `Fixes #18263` and carries `Clause-②: no` as a **bare, line-start, own-line** declaration. ⚠️ ⛔ Not backticked, ⛔ not a heading, ⛔ not sharing the line — this card is literally about that predicate, and three PRs this shift got it wrong. Post the `os-dev-report` on the card and return it.

⛔ Do not mark ready, do not enable auto-merge, do not merge — arming is the PM's act.
⛔ Commit trailer is **model-free**: `Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>` beside `Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_017ef78bLdybu3AffehKkhfk`. The repo's own `.githooks/pre-push` refuses a model identifier there (measured), and no model identifier goes in the PR title, body, code comments or changeset either.

If the card's framing turns out to be measurably wrong, **say so and stop** — that has been the right call four times this shift.
